banner.text: Support session on {{company}}: you are seeing the company's data and cannot change it.

opening.title: Opening environment…
opening.body: One moment: we are opening the customer's environment in read-only mode.

failed.title: Invalid link
failed.expired: This access link has already been used or has expired. Go back to the partner console and open a new one.

ended.title: Session ended
ended.body: The read-only session has ended. To get back in, open a new access from the partner console.
